what_this_is: Five books, one world. Four of them cannot see a single attribute of a single home (fabric-blind); the fifth is the book the company's chooser actually settled. The blind books are the BASELINE the chosen book has to beat, and their min-to-max on each line is the BLIND SPAN. HOW MANY OF THEM ARE IN THAT SPAN IS NOT FIXED AT FIVE AND IS NOT STATED HERE: an arm that cannot be placed in the tree's live housing stock is excluded at publish time with its reason, which is why the page says three where this file holds five. This artefact carries only what each run MEASURED. Every span, position and percentage a reader sees is computed at publish time by `tools.generate_value_arms_data._blind_envelope` -- none is stored here, because a figure kept beside the numbers it is derived from gets edited on two days for two reasons.
comparable_because: All five arms carry world_identity.digest 39a192ce04c1eda8, which is the DEPARTURE LEVEL and is the only reason these are five arms of one world rather than five runs of five worlds. It is NOT sufficient on its own and that was learned the hard way: the departure level does not move when the HOUSING STOCK is re-drawn, so `world_digest` agreed across all five while the houses underneath had changed. The second identity is `home_digest`, and only the four first-hand arms carry it -- all four at 35f8efe8ff02f245, this tree's live stock, re-measured 2026-09-15. ARM C' carries none and cannot. Both digests are carried on the block a reader sees rather than left in a file.
pounds_are_not_publishable: All five arms ran SIM_FAST_MODE=1. For the four first-hand arms this is now EVIDENCED rather than asserted -- each carries its own `execution_mode` block, read from the environment of the process that ran the world and stamped by the same predicate `risk_committee_agent.invoke` branches on (landed 331c4958f). For ARM C' it remains an ASSERTION nobody on this box can falsify, because no run output for it exists here. The differences between the four evidenced arms are therefore clean and the ABSOLUTE pounds are not comparable to docs/reports/run_output_latest.json. No figure here may be published as a headline in pounds -- the surface renders positions and percentages, which is what the shared fast mode earns.
one_seed: Every arm is deterministic at a fixed seed. The blind span is a spread over BOOK SHAPES, not over WORLDS, so it bounds how far the P&L moves when you change which blind book you settle and says nothing about sampling error across worlds. Every verdict below is an ORDERING against the blind arms in the span, never a confidence interval.
second_hand_caveat: ARM C' is the one arm whose P&L this seat did not read from a run output. Its figures are cited from the other seat's result, which is in 34 commits that never reached origin; only its selection artefact (/var/tmp/p6_armC.json) survives on this box. It was carried because it is the only arm holding count, year mix AND spend. IT IS NO LONGER IN THE SPAN. On 2026-09-15 the other four arms were re-run in this tree's live housing stock (35f8efe8ff02f245) and C' could not be -- re-running it here would be a different arm, not this one -- so its figures answer a question about different houses and no span may be taken across all five. It is excluded at publish time and named on the page, rather than left standing as a reason to withhold the whole block: a precondition that one arm can never meet is a wall, not a control, and it was withholding three arms that CAN meet it. The cost is that the span is over three books, which is exactly the floor (`_BLIND_ENVELOPE_MINIMUM_ARMS`), and the block says so.

They are therefore NOT comparable with the other four and no span may be taken across them. This is why the envelope is still refused. DO NOT 'fix' the refusal by inventing a digest for this arm.

provenance_note: WHAT IS AND IS NOT ESTABLISHED ABOUT WHERE THESE FIGURES CAME FROM (stamped 2026-09-15). Until today every arm's `producing_commit` was a bare string like 'p6-arm-cull', which reads as a commit and is a launch label -- the arms' provenance could not be checked from this artefact at all. The labels are kept, under `launch_label`, as the only handle the runs left. What IS a fact: each first-hand arm's `resolved_at`, read back out of its own run output, and `artefact_filed_in_commit`, which is when this file entered git. What is NOT: the sha of the code that drew the figures, for the reason each arm now states.

re_run_2026-09-15.what: The four FIRST-HAND arms (A_cull, C_cull83, D_tenure, B_chosen) were re-run from a clean `git archive` extract of 331c4958f and re-filed with their own home digest, their own execution mode, their own real producing commit and their own five figures. ARM C' was NOT re-run and must not be.
re_run_2026-09-15.why: They were filed on 09-11 with `producing_commit.commit` null (the launcher had passed a LABEL where a sha belonged) and with no record of which houses they ran on. The housing stock has since moved through the fork-closing merge 2212d0eed, so the old figures answered a question about a different country.
re_run_2026-09-15.harness_unchanged: Same extract, same arm_rerun.py, same SIM_FAST_MODE=1, same sequential order cull/cull83/tenure/chosen, same ARM_PRODUCING_COMMIT. Only the code commit and the housing stock moved, so the four stay comparable with EACH OTHER exactly as the 09-11 four were.
re_run_2026-09-15.launcher: `systemd-run --user --unit=blind-arms-rerun`, NOT `setsid`. The first attempt at 17:52:06Z used setsid and every arm was killed at 8m41s by the worker tick's cgroup, writing no output at all. See docs/staging/SEAT_FINDING_THE_DRAWN_PREMISE_CHECKED_A_COMMIT_AND_THE_THING_THAT_MATTERED_WAS_FOUR_DEAD_PROCESSES_2026-09-15.md
re_run_2026-09-15.the_envelope_is_still_refused_and_that_i: Filing these four does NOT make `blind_envelope.available` true, and anyone reading the drawn instruction as if it would has mis-read the consumer. `_blind_envelope_homes_refusal` requires EVERY arm to carry a home_digest equal to the live stock; C' carries none. The refusal therefore still fires -- but it now names 1 of 5 books instead of 5 of 5, and the thing standing between this page and a published baseline is one specific, named, un-rerunnable arm rather than a general absence.
